# f5xc_http_loadbalancer_service_policy_attachments (Resource)

Manages the complete list of attached F5 XC Service Policies for an HTTP LoadBalancer resource.

To get more information about f5xc_http_loadbalancer_service_policy_attachments, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api)



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `http_loadbalancer_name` (String) Name of the target HTTP LoadBalancer.
- `service_policies` (List of String) Authoritative list of Service Policy names attached to this HTTP LoadBalancer.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the target HTTP LoadBalancer (defaults to `default`).
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the association in the format `namespace/http_loadbalancer_name`.
